fields.Name: T072 - Testing Review Tab
fields.Description: Opens the Testing app Review tab once, then exercises the human review queue (submission write-path and queue/history view toggle) in one run, verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T169, T170.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, choose 'Testing', then click the 'Review' tab. Then perform these sub-actions IN ORDER, and as you complete each set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) review-queue-submission — the Human Review view shows a KPI summary row and a Review Queue; if pending accordion items exist, expand one, pick a Rating number, click a correctness button (Correct or Incorrect), optionally type a note, then click Submit and confirm the item is accepted (it leaves the queue or shows a submitted state); if the queue is empty, confirming the 'All caught up!' empty state renders correctly is also success; (2) review-history-toggle — near the top there is a view toggle with 'Review Queue' and 'History' buttons; click 'History' and confirm the content switches to the reviewed/history view, then click 'Review Queue' to switch back (each view shows content or a valid empty state). Keep going until both sub-actions are done. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

checkpoints.name: review-queue-submission
checkpoints.instruction: reach Review tab; submit a review or confirm empty-state
visualCriteria: The Review tab shows a KPI summary row and a Review Queue; if items exist, expanding one reveals a rating scale, correctness buttons, and a notes field and Submit removes/updates the item once a rating/correctness is chosen; if empty, the 'All caught up!' empty-state renders cleanly

checkpoints.name: review-history-toggle
checkpoints.instruction: toggle between Review Queue and History views
visualCriteria: The Review tab shows a Review Queue / History view toggle; clicking History switches to the history view and clicking Review Queue switches back, each rendering its content or a valid empty state
